newsitem.title: GREECE: Ergobank to proceed with rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Ergobank to proceed with rights issue.

text.p: Greece's Ergobank will go ahead with a 26.5 billion drachma rights issue between January 27 and February 28, it said on Tuesday following a shareholders' meeting.

Ergobank shares will trade ex-rights on January 27. It will issue 6,636,000 new registered shares at 4,000 drachmas each. Rights will entitle shareholders to seven new shares for every 20 outstanding.
Shareholders approved a bonus issue of 604,000 shares -- one bonus for every 30 outstanding -- resulting from a capitalisation of reserves.
But the new shares arising from the rights issue will not be entitled to the bonus distribution.
Ergobank will also raise the par value of its shares to 850 drachmas from 843 presently after capitalising reserves, it said.
Shareholders cleared an issue of 294,000 shares that will be exclusively distributed to Ergobank staff at 4,000 drachmas as well.
All new shares will be entitled to the 1997 dividend.
The rights issue will boost the bank's equity capital to 90 billion drachmas, it said. Its shares closed up 265 drachmas at 12,555 on Tuesday, a gain of 2.16 percent.
